deliverBody: Our drivers run scheduled routes across Southwest Florida. They learn your hours, your back door and where the boxes go.
lead: For more than 30 years we have kept local shops, kitchens and shipping rooms stocked, with real people to ask and trucks that show up when we say they will.
photoAlt: A tidy warehouse aisle with shelves of flat-packed boxes and rolls of bubble wrap
story1: ipac began as a packing supply company helping local businesses ship their products safely. Customers kept asking for one more thing, so the shelves kept growing: from boxes and tape to take-out containers, cleaning supplies and nearly everything else a small business uses up.
story2: What has not changed is how we work. We visit, we look at what you actually pack and we recommend what fits. Then we deliver it.
storyTitle: Started with boxes. Grew with our customers.
title: The supply room for Southwest Florida's small businesses.
val1Body: Long enough to know most of our customers by first name.
val2Body: Shipping, food service and facility supplies on a single order and a single invoice.
val3Body: Order as a guest in minutes, or open an account for terms and recurring deliveries.
vanAlt: A navy delivery van loaded with kraft boxes outside a storefront
